snippet.title: Theorem
snippet.description: Theorem is a solid and clever puzzle game in which you roll a cube, but one face is forbidden. Activate mechanics, teleport yourself on another place, take pearls and make use of impossible geometry so as to reach your goal. 50 levels ++
